title: Meet your team
purpose: Join your school team and choose a crew.
steps: Ask your lead how to join the approved chat.
Say hello and pick Dance, Media or Ops.
submit: Tell your lead which team you picked.
approval: Do not share private contact details in the chat.
assignment:
T01 — Meet your team
Ask your lead how to join the approved group chat. Say hello and share which team you want to join. Proof: Tell your lead which team you picked. Safety: Do not share private contact details in the chat.

title: Find interested students
purpose: Find students who might want to join H4.
steps: Ask a few friends if they want to learn about H4.
Share the official signup link where your school allows it.
Count how many people are interested.
submit: Report how many students showed interest; no names or phone numbers.
approval: Use the official signup form; do not collect contact lists.
assignment:
T02 — Find interested students
Ask a few friends if they want to learn about H4. Share the approved signup link only where allowed. Proof: Report how many students showed interest; no names or phone numbers. Safety: Use the official signup form; do not collect contact lists.

title: Learn your school rules
purpose: Find out how to get school approval.
steps: Ask your teacher or the office about flyers, clubs and announcements.
Write down who approves each activity.
submit: Write down the rules and who must approve each activity.
approval: Do not post or announce anything yet.
assignment:
T03 — Learn your school rules
Ask the office or a teacher how students can post flyers, start a club or make announcements. Proof: Write down the rules and who must approve each activity. Safety: Do not post or announce anything yet.

title: Make a team intro
purpose: Make a short introduction for your school team.
steps: Write who your team is and what you hope to do.
Make a short text or Canva draft.
Send it to your lead for review.
submit: Send the draft or a view-only link to your lead.
approval: Keep it private until an adult approves it; no unapproved photos.
assignment:
T04 — Make a team intro
Create a short text or Canva draft introducing your H4 school team and what you hope to do. Proof: Send the draft or a view-only link to your lead. Safety: Keep it private until an adult approves it; no unapproved photos.

title: Find potential teachers
purpose: Find a teacher who could support H4.
steps: Think of teachers who support arts, dance, leadership or clubs.
Pick up to three staff roles and find the school contact route.

resources.label: Public school website or school office

submit: Send the director/lead the approved school contact route and why each might help.
approval: Use school contact channels, not private contact details.
assignment:
T05 — Find potential teachers
Think of teachers who support dance, arts, leadership or clubs. List up to three teacher roles or school contacts. Proof: Send the director/lead the approved school contact route and why each might help. Safety: Use school contact channels, not private contact details.

title: Introduce H4 to a teacher
purpose: Find out whether a teacher is interested in H4.
steps: Practise the teacher introduction.
Offer the teacher the workshop handout.
Ask if H4 can follow up.
submit: Send the teacher’s response and next step privately to your lead.
approval: Do not promise a date, cost or booking. Adults handle follow-up.
assignment:
T06 — Introduce H4 to a teacher
Use the teacher script. Give the teacher the workshop handout. Ask if they want H4 to contact them. Proof: Send the teacher’s response and next step privately to your lead. Safety: Do not promise a date, cost or booking. Adults handle follow-up.

title: Make a flyer
purpose: Make a recruitment flyer for review.
steps: Use the flyer copy and official QR code.
Make a Canva draft and check both signup routes.
Send the draft to your lead.
submit: Submit a draft link or image for review.
approval: An adult and school must approve before posting.
assignment:
T07 — Make a flyer
Use the flyer copy in the kit. Make a Canva draft. Keep the real signup link and QR code correct. Proof: Submit a draft link or image for review. Safety: An adult and school must approve before posting.

title: Write a school announcement
purpose: Draft a short announcement for your school.
steps: Copy the announcement script.
Add your school name if allowed.
Ask your lead to check it and find out who approves it.
submit: Submit the draft and the approval step you found.
approval: Office or teacher approval is needed before it goes live.
assignment:
T08 — Write a school announcement
Copy the announcement template. Add your school name if allowed. Ask your lead to check it. Proof: Submit the draft and the approval step you found. Safety: Office or teacher approval is needed before it goes live.

title: Ask about workshop dates
purpose: Help a teacher suggest possible workshop times.
steps: Ask which times and spaces could work.
Ask what approvals are needed.
Write down two options or the next step.
submit: Report two possible times or what the teacher says is needed.
approval: Do not book rooms or confirm dates yourself.
assignment:
T09 — Ask about workshop dates
Ask the interested teacher what times, spaces and approval steps could work. Proof: Report two possible times or what the teacher says is needed. Safety: Do not book rooms or confirm dates yourself.

title: Help with a workshop
purpose: Help with one supervised workshop job.
steps: Wait for the director to confirm the workshop.
Ask your supervisor for one role: setup, welcome, materials or cleanup.
Follow the adult’s instructions and note your actual time.
submit: Report what you did and actual time spent.
approval: No unsupervised teaching or collection of permission forms.
assignment:
T10 — Help with a workshop
After the director confirms the event, ask for one safe role: setup, welcome, materials or cleanup. Follow the supervising adult. Proof: Report what you did and actual time spent. Safety: No unsupervised teaching or collection of permission forms.

title: Learn how to start a club
purpose: Find out what your school needs to approve a club.
steps: Ask your teacher or school office about club rules.
Write down the steps and any deadlines.
submit: Summarize the steps and any deadlines.
approval: Do not submit an application without a teacher.
assignment:
T11 — Learn how to start a club
Ask a teacher or the school office for the club rules and application steps. Proof: Summarize the steps and any deadlines. Safety: Do not submit an application without a teacher.

title: Find a club teacher
purpose: Find a teacher who might supervise the club.
steps: Use the teacher introduction script.
Ask whether the teacher might supervise an H4 club.
submit: Report interest or the next person to ask.
approval: A teacher decides whether they can supervise.
assignment:
T12 — Find a club teacher
Use the teacher script. Ask if they might supervise an H4 club. Proof: Report interest or the next person to ask. Safety: A teacher decides whether they can supervise.

title: Plan an H4 club
purpose: Make a first draft of your school club plan.
steps: Fill in the club planning sheet with your team.
Suggest a goal, time, space and activities.
Ask your teacher and lead to review it.
submit: Share the draft with your lead and teacher.
approval: No club meetings until school approval.
assignment:
T13 — Plan an H4 club
Fill in the club plan template with your team. Suggest a goal, meeting time, space and activities. Proof: Share the draft with your lead and teacher. Safety: No club meetings until school approval.

title: Plan the first meeting
purpose: Plan a short first meeting for your team.
steps: Start with the first meeting agenda.
Choose one icebreaker, one activity and one next step.
Plan for 20–30 minutes.
submit: Submit a simple 20–30 minute agenda.
approval: Run it only with an approved adult present.
assignment:
T14 — Plan the first meeting
Use the first-meeting agenda. Add one icebreaker, one activity and one next step. Proof: Submit a simple 20–30 minute agenda. Safety: Run it only with an approved adult present.

title: Find dance crew interest
purpose: Find students who want to join a beginner-friendly crew.
steps: Tell interested students about H4.
Share the approved signup route.
Ask what they would like to practise.
submit: Report the number interested and suggested practice ideas.
approval: No tryouts or exclusion; do not collect personal data.
assignment:
T15 — Find dance crew interest
Tell interested students about H4 and share the approved signup route. Ask about beginner-friendly practice ideas. Proof: Report the number interested and suggested practice ideas. Safety: No tryouts or exclusion; do not collect personal data.

title: Make a practice plan
purpose: Plan a safe, beginner-friendly practice.
steps: Ask a teacher about space and supervision.
Write a warmup, beginner moves and a cooldown.
Send the plan for adult review.
submit: Send the plan for adult review.
approval: No unsafe moves, unsupervised practice or unconfirmed bookings.
assignment:
T16 — Make a practice plan
Ask your teacher about space and supervision. Draft a warmup, beginner moves and cooldown. Proof: Send the plan for adult review. Safety: No unsafe moves, unsupervised practice or unconfirmed bookings.

title: Teach one move on video
purpose: Show your team how to do one move you know.
steps: Pick a safe move you already know.
Film yourself slowly and at normal speed, or write the steps.
Share only through a private, approved route.
submit: Send a private approved link or describe the steps if you cannot film.
approval: No other people in frame without approval; no public posting.
assignment:
T17 — Teach one move on video
Choose a safe move you know. Film yourself showing it slowly and at normal speed. Proof: Send a private approved link or describe the steps if you cannot film. Safety: No other people in frame without approval; no public posting.

title: Find a nearby school
purpose: Find nearby schools that could be a fit for H4.
steps: Find up to three nearby schools.
Find each school office’s public contact page.
Send the links to the H4 director.
submit: Send school names and public website links to the director.
approval: Do not contact students at other schools without an approved route.
assignment:
T18 — Find a nearby school
Find up to three nearby schools and their public office contact pages. Proof: Send school names and public website links to the director. Safety: Do not contact students at other schools without an approved route.

title: Find community spaces
purpose: Find possible spaces for supervised youth activities.
steps: Look up to three community centres or libraries.
Save public links and one reason each space might fit.

resources.label: Public community centre or library websites

submit: Send names, public links and one reason each might fit.
approval: Do not visit alone or contact staff on behalf of H4 without approval.
assignment:
T19 — Find community spaces
Find up to three community centres or libraries with possible youth activity space. Proof: Send names, public links and one reason each might fit. Safety: Do not visit alone or contact staff on behalf of H4 without approval.

title: Draft an outreach message
purpose: Write a first outreach message for the director to review.
steps: Start with the community outreach template.
Explain what H4 does and why the space might fit.
Ask for a conversation and send the draft to the director.
submit: Send the draft to the director.
approval: Do not send it yourself unless an adult approves the route and text.
assignment:
T20 — Draft an outreach message
Use the outreach template. Explain H4, why the place might be a good fit and ask for a conversation. Proof: Send the draft to the director. Safety: Do not send it yourself unless an adult approves the route and text.
